title: Tomcat 8 Manager Weak Password and WAR Upload
description: Apache Tomcat 8.0 with the Manager application open to remote addresses and an account with a weak password: guessing the credentials gives access to /manager/html, where uploading a WAR file deploys a JSP shell.
question: Get into the Tomcat Manager with its weak password, deploy a WAR file, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
